scripts.dev: bun run db:migrate:local && bun run build:shared && turbo run dev --filter=@xray/shared --filter=@xray/ui --filter=@xray/worker
scripts.dev:ui: bun run build:shared && turbo run dev --filter=@xray/shared --filter=@xray/ui
scripts.dev:worker: bun run db:migrate:local && bun run build:shared && turbo run dev --filter=@xray/shared --filter=@xray/worker
scripts.deploy: bun run build && turbo run deploy --filter=@xray/worker
scripts.test:l2: bun run --filter @xray/worker test:e2e && bun run gate:routes
scripts.db:migrate:local: cd packages/worker && bunx wrangler d1 migrations apply xray-db --local --env development
